etymologies.etymologyHTML: From sales +‎ -man.

definitions.definition: A man whose job it is to sell things, either in a shop  / store or elsewhere.

quote.text: There was an auto salesman in here yesterday that claimed you could always tell a fellow's class by the car he drove, but I says to him, 'Don't be silly,' I says; 'the wisenheimers grab a look at a fellow's nails when they want to tell if he's a tin-horn or a real gent!"'

quote.citation: 1954, United States. Congress. Senate. Committee on Banking and Currency. Subcommittee on Housing and Urban Affairs, FHA Investigation: Hearings, page 2397:
quote.text: Would you say it was fair to describe these salesmen that were in your crews as dynamiters, or suede shoe salesmen?
